reason: The README describes reusable browser-plugin workspace UI primitives centered on pane layouts, tree navigation, tabbed editors, document surfaces, and explorer behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器插件提供可组合的工作区界面组件，包括可拖拽面板、树形视图、标签式文档编辑器和文档渲染区域。
summaries.en: Provides composable workspace UI primitives for DeepSeek Harness browser plugins, including draggable panes, tree views, tabbed document editors, and document rendering surfaces.
